visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static shot of elevator doors in a bright hallway, which open to reveal a large promotional poster for the Monster Hunter 20th Anniversary exhibition. (2) The camera moves into the venue, showing a spacious entrance with staff members in black uniforms standing near a large, colorful mural of various monsters. (3) A close-up shot focuses on commemorative tickets held in a hand, followed by shots of detailed Felyne statues in costumes. (4) The scene transitions to a long wall covered in dozens of small monitors displaying historical game footage in a dimly lit gallery setting. (5) A young man with long dark hair, wearing a blue cap and a black t-shirt, is shown interacting with a large touchscreen displaying a catalog of monster icons. (6) Large-scale physical weapon replicas, including a glowing blue and white greatsword, are shown on pedestals with dramatic spotlights. (7) The creator is seen putting on a white VR headset in a circular area marked with floor decals, reacting with surprise to the virtual content. (8) The camera pans across the merchandise section, showing shelves of branded hats, t-shirts, and plush toys; the creator is seen hugging a large green monster plush. (9) The final segment shows themed blue and green bottled drinks and patterned waffles being served in a cafe area.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the iconic, triumphant orchestral fanfare of the Monster Hunter main theme, featuring loud brass and heavy percussive timpani. A subtle electronic elevator chime rings out at the start. (2) As the visuals cut through the entrance, the music transitions seamlessly into another high-energy track from the game series. Light ambient chatter and the shuffling of feet can be heard behind the dominant BGM. (3) The main speaker begins to talk with an excited, high-arousal tone, expressing delight as he explores the history wall; his voice is clear with a rising intonation pattern. (4) During the VR segment, the music continues with a strong, driving beat. Sharp 'whoosh' sound effects are inserted at scene transitions, synchronized with fast camera cuts. (5) The recording ends with a final musical flourish as the speaker's voice lowers in volume, replaced by the soft sounds of beverage bottles clinking on a counter.
